need.title: HOA election — candidates named
need.body: Nov 4 Annual Meeting election. Candidates: Kevin Dawyskiba, Michael Ross, Ronald Sedlak, Stacey Weber. Bios on TownSq. Ballot and voting instructions mail in the next few days (physical ballot or electronic). Meet the Candidates night in October — date pending candidate availability.

need.title: HOA Town Hall Oct 7 at 1:00 PM on Zoom
need.body: Wed Oct 7 1:00 PM Zoom. Jayson Salter (Castle Group F&B) on High Tide and Waterline. Pulte Land on pond washouts. Questions to Megan Heins mheins@castlegroup.com by Tue Oct 6. Meeting ID 989-365-024-39, password 150951. Recorded and posted after.

need.title: SWFWMD watering restrictions through Mar 31 2027
need.body: Southwest Florida Water Management District extended watering restrictions through March 31, 2027. HOA, Sunnygrove, and Pulte are reviewing irrigation, landscaping, and sod replacement. Landscape inquiries go to sunnygrovemaintenance.com/?assoc=7370.

need.title: LSV golf carts — county road rules
need.body: Sarasota County: LSVs only on roads posted 35 mph or less. Licensed/registered carts may use E Manasota Beach Rd to cross 776. Register every BeachWalk cart with the HOA before use.
